name: flowfunc
description: Dash wrapper for flume node editor

scripts.build:backends: python -c "import json, subprocess, os, os.path, dash; from dash.development.component_generator import generate_components; extract = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(dash.__file__), 'extract-meta.js'); env = os.environ.copy(); env['MODULES_PATH'] = os.path.abspath('./node_modules'); out = subprocess.check_output(['node', extract, '\\.test\\.', '^UNDEFINED$|^REQUIRED$|^to_plotly_json$|^available_properties$|^available_wildcard_properties$|^_.*$', './src/lib/components'], env=env); metadata = json.loads(out.decode('utf-8')); generate_components('./src/lib/components','flowfunc', package_info_filename='package-info.json', ignore='\\.test\\.', metadata=metadata)"
scripts.build: npm run build:js && npm run build:backends
scripts.build:activated: npm run build:js && npm run build:backends-activated
